body.name: Generic positive-real covariance class \(\mathsf{Cov}_p(G)\)
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Cov}_p(G)=\{G':\overline{G'}=\overline G,\ C\setminus\operatorname{cl}_{C}(\mathcal E_p(G,G')\cap C)\text{ has empty }\operatorname{relint}_{C}\text{ for every full-dimensional connected semialgebraic chamber }C\text{ of }\mathcal M^{\circ}_{\mathrm{branch},p,q}(G,G')\}\), where the chambers fix the signs of the nonzero structural coefficients, changes, and \(t_k-v_k\), and closure and relative interior are taken in \(C\). This is a generic chamberwise functional and makes no pointwise assertion on the variance-neutral hyperplanes of the ambient model.
